information_loss: reduces each nuclide to its (N, Z) pair; drops spin, excitation spectrum, and binding energy.

ordered_parameter.declaration: ordered by increasing (A, Z): H-1, H-2, He-4, Li-7, C-12

physical_provenance: nuclide chart (N, Z) counts; standard nuclear data
recurrence_mapping: Neutron/proton ratio N/Z as an exact rational: H-1 0/1, H-2 1/1, He-4 2/2 = 1, Li-7 4/3, C-12 6/6 = 1. The value N/Z = 1 recurs for the even-even N=Z nuclei He-4 and C-12.
